svg.title: The Pulse workflow and how pairs of a person and their agents share the work
svg.desc: Top: the workflow as a line of ten steps, each with who works and what it leaves behind. Business analysis (/pulse-ba), you and an agent: Project-BA and Item-BA. Requirements (/pulse-re), you and an agent: feature specs and the architect handoff. Plan (/pulse-plan), an agent: the PLAN and decision records. Build (/pulse-build), an agent: spec tests, code, unit tests. Tests (verify), run by pulse: a test result per commit. Review (/pulse-review) and audit (/pulse-audit), agents in fresh sessions: a review report and an audit report, pass or block. Pull request, opened by pulse: the pull request with its gate table and Closes #n. Merge, you: the feature on the base branch, the item closed. Release, you: a versioned release. You decide at business analysis, requirements, the merge, and at the plan only when it is held. Plan to pull request run under pulse go for each approved feature in parallel. A red gate goes back to the build and all gates run again; a requirement gap goes back from plan to requirements, a design gap from build to plan; release outcomes go back to business analysis. Bottom: the map that everyone sees. 1: pulse go claims the front item of the ramp, which the team orders and approves. 2: each person works with their own agents, one worktree and branch per item, and runs plan to pull request. 3: a pair hands back a pull request with the gate reports; you merge it. 4: the merge closes the item and waiting work moves up the ramp; a failed build returns its item to the ramp. The board on GitHub stores the state behind the map; only pulse writes it, and every map reads it.
svg.text: The flow: each step and what it leaves behind
you and an agent: what and why
pulse go: each approved feature, in parallel, on its own branch
red gate: fix, then all gates again
outcomes go back to /pulse-ba: did the hypotheses hold?
Who takes what: human and agent pairs, coordinated by the map
Each person runs pulse go with their own agents. Everyone sees the same map.
terminal and sidebar, updated within seconds
each agent runs plan to pull request, in its own worktree
draft PR: a gate stayed red,
merge closes the item and waiting work moves up; a failed build returns its item to the ramp
one record per item: approved, rank, claim, blockers, open or closed. Only pulse writes it.
only when the PLAN is held
